attribution: Achievement data from Steam (Steam Web API, app 960990)
StrategyWiki: no usable walkthrough, nothing used — https://strategywiki.org/wiki/Beyond:_Two_Souls
Fandom (beyondtwosouls.fandom.com, CC BY-SA): page names only were checked to confirm structure; no text copied — https://beyondtwosouls.fandom.com/wiki/Beyond:_Two_Souls
notes: Backlog game, all-AAA pass: picked from RAWG's most-added list for its year across all genres (docs/PLAN.md section 2, genre filter widened 2026-10-23). RAWG's first result is the expected entry (id 3028); RAWG lists "Heavy Rain & Beyond: Two Souls Collection" and "Quantic Dream Collection" as additions. Steam app 960990 ("Beyond: Two Souls") was used. 43 of 45 Steam achievements are hidden and only "Two Souls" (Duo mode) and "All Endings..." have descriptions, so nearly every placement is a guess from the name alone. Skill-sounding names (Entities, Channeling, Fight and Stealth apprentice and master, plus "Uncontrollable") sit in one chapter; three romance names in another; seven names about choices and endings in a third ("A Better World" and "Saved All" are guesses). The other 27 sit in the main story chapter. StrategyWiki has a page at completion stage 0 (marked as a stub): Gameplay, Walkthrough and Table of Contents are linked but not written, and no subpages exist. beyond.fandom.com has no page under this title; beyondtwosouls.fandom.com answers the API under "Beyond: Two Souls" with about 42 linked articles. Its "Chapters" page links about 41 pages (such as "Prologue", "First Night", "The Embassy", "Navajo", "Black Sun (chapter)" and "Epilogue"), but the API lists them alphabetically, so their order is not in the data and the story was not split by chapter. Names only were looked at, nothing copied.
